title: 11 Day Uganda Birding Tour
rank_math_title: Uganda Birding Tour: 11 Wonderful Days with Shoebill
rank_math_desc: Uganda birding tour for 11 days: Mabamba shoebill, Kibale chimps, Queen Elizabeth, Bwindi and Lake Mburo, with an optional gorilla trek. Price on request.
post_content: This Uganda birding tour fits the country's highlights into 11 days: shoebill, chimpanzees, the Kazinga Channel, Bwindi and Lake Mburo.
overview:
This Uganda birding tour is a well-paced 11-day route for travellers who want great birding with time to enjoy each place. It covers wetland, rainforest, savannah and mountain forest, with chimpanzees and an optional gorilla trek.

Two nights around Entebbe give you a gentle start, with Lake Victoria's shoreline and the famous shoebill at Mabamba.

Why choose this Uganda birding tour?

  • Entebbe: hornbills, kingfishers and palm-nut vultures by Lake Victoria.
  • Mabamba: canoe trip for the shoebill.
  • Kibale: chimpanzees, grey parrots and Narina trogon.
  • Queen Elizabeth: skimmers, martial eagles and the Kazinga Channel launch.
  • Bwindi and Lake Mburo: forest endemics, then savannah birds and zebras.

Where you stay

An Entebbe hotel by the lake, a lodge near Kibale, Mweya Safari Lodge in Queen Elizabeth, a camp in Buhoma and a lodge at Lake Mburo, such as Mantana Tented Camp, or similar.

Best time for a Uganda birding tour

Uganda is good all year. June to August and December to February are the driest months. The wetter months bring breeding birds and lush green scenery.

See our Uganda national parks guide, the Bwindi gorilla trekking guide and all Uganda safaris. Permits are managed by the Uganda Wildlife Authority.

How much does the Uganda birding tour cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges you choose, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

faq.q: Is gorilla trekking included in the Uganda birding tour?
faq.a: It is optional on day 8. We can add a permit for you.
Yes. One chimpanzee tracking permit is included in Kibale.

faq.q: How many birds will I see?
faq.a: Most guests record 350 to 450 species in 11 days.
An Entebbe hotel, a lodge near Kibale, Mweya Safari Lodge, a Buhoma camp and a Lake Mburo lodge, or similar.

faq.q: Is this trip suitable for beginners?
faq.a: Yes. The pace is relaxed and your guide helps you find and identify every bird.
Most drives are three to six hours, broken up with birding stops.
Yes. Semliki can be added for two nights after Kibale for Congo Basin forest birds.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.content: Airport pick-up and transfer to your hotel near Lake Victoria.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Entebbe birding
itinerary.content: Bird the lakeshore and forest edges for casqued hornbills, palm-nut vultures, long-crested eagles and kingfishers.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Mabamba to Kibale
itinerary.content: Canoe trip at Mabamba for the shoebill, then drive west to a lodge near Kibale.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Kibale National Park
itinerary.content: Chimpanzee tracking and forest birding for grey parrot, African emerald cuckoo and Narina trogon.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Kibale to Queen Elizabeth
itinerary.content: Morning in Kibale, then drive to Mweya Safari Lodge in Queen Elizabeth National Park.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth and Kazinga Channel
itinerary.content: Morning game drive and an afternoon launch trip for skimmers, herons and hippos.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth to Bwindi
itinerary.content: Drive south to Buhoma for forest birding in Bwindi.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Bwindi forest or gorilla trek
itinerary.content: Forest birding for alethes, warblers and wattle-eyes, or an optional gorilla trek.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Bwindi to Lake Mburo
itinerary.content: Drive east to Lake Mburo with birding stops.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Lake Mburo National Park
itinerary.content: Savannah birding for go-away-birds, francolins and lovebirds, plus a boat ride.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Lake Mburo to Entebbe
itinerary.content: Final morning of birding, then drive to Entebbe for a farewell dinner and your evening flight.
